hints.content:
The combination with the least number of jasmine plants within this range is represented by the point whose $J$-coordinate is the *smallest*. This is the point $(12,8)$.

There is a solid line representing the inequality of the number of plants Wladyslaw watered. This inequality goes through the points zero, twenty and twenty, zero. hints.content: Wladyslaw must water at least $12$ jasmine plants to meet both his constraints.

question.content:
Wladyslaw wants to water jasmine plants and lily plants in his garden. His goal is to water at least $20$ plants (condition $A$) with $12$ liters of water at most (condition $B$).

The graph represents the constraints on the number of jasmine $J$ and lily $L$ plants Wladyslaw waters.



[[☃ image 1]]

**What is the least number of jasmine plants Wladyslaw must water to meet both his constraints?**
